english.title: Without authority bring a loaded shotgun / air weapon / firearm with ammunition onto the Midland Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), brought a

(A)_[loaded shotgun]_
(B)_[loaded air weapon]_
